title: Asteroid Defence System: Sandia scientists develop 1,600 times faster model to deflect space rocks- Moneycontrol.com
excerpt: Scientists have developed a computer model that simulates asteroid deflection more than 1,600 times faster than earlier methods. The research examines how X-ray blasts could change an asteroid's movement and potentially help protect Earth.
content:
Scientists have developed a computer model that simulates asteroid deflection more than 1,600 times faster than earlier methods. The research examines how X-ray blasts could change an asteroid's movement and potentially help protect Earth.

November 04, 2026 / 18:20 IST

Scientists are studying how X-ray radiation could help divert dangerous asteroids away from Earth. (Image: AI Representative)

  • New model simulates asteroid deflection 1,600x faster.
  • X-ray blast direction alters asteroid velocity changes.
  • Research aids future planetary defense planning.
